Lecture mode needs more free memory. Close other apps and retry, or use Compatibility mode for a new transcript. Your audio is kept.
Lecture mode · automatic language · audio kept

Lecture mode recognises Romanian, English and 23 other European languages automatically. Use Compatibility for a fixed language or Turkish. Numbers are underlined for checking; medical terms can also be wrong. Lecture mode always keeps audio.
Create a separate transcript with %1$s mode from the retained audio. Your original text, corrections and recording stay unchanged. All source audio must still be available.
